created 2026-11-19 · updated 2026-11-19 · inline-marks-task-s                                       
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Inline marks on a task's text; resolved dialogue moves to a history file                            
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> ? Should questions and requests both become threads, so the ## Questions and ## Requests sections 
    are replaced (old ones migrated), or do threads sit beside them?                                
    └ question 1 · crab · 10 min ago · answer                                                       
                                                                                                    
  ? Who may resolve a thread: only the person who opened it, or also the agent once it has acted on 
    it?                                                                                             
    └ question 2 · crab · 10 min ago · answer                                                       
                                                                                                    
  ? Besides task text, should threads anchor to an attached file such as a mock sheet (a region or a
    line in it)?                                                                                    
    └ question 3 · crab · 10 min ago · answer                                                       
                                                                                                    
DESCRIPTION                                                                                         
The ticket stays the crisp working document. A person or agent marks a piece of a task's text with  
a comment, question or request that sits inline in the text, visible as text, with a recognizable   
sigil. The agent picks marks up, acts or answers, and resolves each by rewriting the ticket text    
to the clarified result and removing the mark. The dialogue that led there (the mark, replies, who  
and when) is appended to a history file attached to the task, never kept in the ticket.             
                                                                                                    
PURPOSE                                                                                             
Jørgen 2026-11-19 08:55Z: attach a request to a piece of the text in a mark mode, so the AI knows
